name: The Greenwich Hotel
insider_take: Where Robert De Niro's vision meets Tribeca sophistication – this is luxury lodging as personal sanctuary.
whats_special: Co-owned by Robert De Niro, each of the 88 rooms features one-of-a-kind antiques and artwork collected from around the world. The hotel houses a 250-year-old farmhouse from Kyoto as its centerpiece and boasts the exclusive Shibui Spa with a lantern-lit swimming pool in a hand-carved stone grotto.
pro_tip: Book the Penthouse's private rooftop terrace for unobstructed views of the Hudson River – it's where A-listers escape the city buzz without leaving Manhattan.
dont_miss: Locanda Verde downstairs for their legendary weekend brunch, and a stroll through nearby Washington Market Park where locals play while you're steps from the historic Tribeca cobblestones that have hosted countless film shoots.
pros: Boutique luxury hotel with unique, handcrafted design elements
Prime Tribeca location with easy access to NYC attractions
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Shibui Spa featuring authentic Japanese treatments
cons: Intimate boutique size with limited room inventory
